answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by reserving 1,000 distinct server compute slots, ensuring each occupies a unique execution path that remains reserved as a mesa of dedicated capacity. A central verifier audits these slots using a shale-hardened probe to detect signal interference, denying any attempt to share capacity. An ocean of latency measurements confirms that each agent holds a token linked to its specific reservation, proving exclusive occupancy. Honest participants pay 1x cost, while fakes pay 1,000x for isolated slots, with immediate identity revocation for any failed audit.
